_why: Which terminal each lane's Task belongs to, so a dispatch that never attached can still be placed. A dispatch records its assignee only once worker-start succeeds; the common stall is that it never did, because worker-start waits for a busy agent's TUI and gives up after a minute. Without this map the resume script knows a lane is stalled and has nowhere to put it. Written by the coordinator, read by resume_lanes.py. A handle that no longer exists is skipped rather than guessed at.
_retired: Lane B (task_3599a96308c4, term_e81409be) retired 2026-08-18 at 100% context; its files went to Lanes H and I in M0-W355. Removed from the map so the sweep stops reporting a lane that is deliberately finished -- a monitor with a permanent false alarm trains the reader to skim it.
